title: A critical review of a hidden epidemic: examining the occupational and environmental risk factors of chronic kidney disease of unknown etiology (CKDu)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00304G, Critical Review
Open Access

Madeleine Bradley, Danielle Land, Darrin A. Thompson, David M. Cwiertny
A form of chronic kidney disease has been described in people without any known risk factors. These cases are referred to as chronic kidney disease of an unknown etiology (CKDu).
